module: Flowgraph node "Race Recovery Used" (category logic, tag scenario). Signals when a vehicle has used a recovery in the race (events.recovered). Outputs: flow, impulse (pulse), recoveriesUsed (total number of recoveries of the vehicle) and recoveredTo (recovery point used, nil otherwise).
notes: The flow pin is never reset to false by this node once it has become true (only impulse is reset to false every frame).
work() indexes race.states[vehId] without an existence check.

work.desc: Reads the vehicle's events and fills flow, impulse, recoveredTo and recoveriesUsed.
